patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct price peaks visible near the 1850 level separated by a decline to approximately 1800. Current price at 1799 is retesting the intermediate trough/neckline area after the second peak.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed two highs near 1850 with a pullback between them to around 1800. Current price is testing the 1800 support area. A breakdown below this level would confirm bearish reversal.
limitations: Pattern is not yet confirmed; price is currently at the neckline and could bounce back up.
Exact peak and trough levels are visual estimates from the chart.
